analysis: Trial crashed: the host reports train.py exited with status 1 after 78.49 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was returned. The supplied traceback contains only the subprocess failure, so it does not identify the failing category, operation, or underlying exception. The diagnostic patch was intended to record that context in working/training_error.txt and logs, but those contents are absent here. Neither a root cause nor a training fix is established; model quality remains unmeasured.
code_summary: One independently trained SASRec model per category, with four-category routing and exactly one selected checkpoint loaded per route. Each model uses 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.3, and maximum history length 100. A jointly trained gated branch fuses the causal mean of the last five valid item embeddings into Transformer features. Scores use tied item embeddings plus learned item biases. Training uses sampled cross-entropy with 2,048 shared uniform negatives, up to 2,048 positive tokens per batch, AdamW, learning-rate warmup, and seed 42. Validation selects one checkpoint by HR@10 with NDCG as a tie-breaker. The code includes fusion, serialization, and exported-predictor checks; their successful completion is not established by the supplied result. No ensemble or checkpoint averaging is implemented.
